description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer for C# code that inspects interface and type declarations within the Orleans framework. It verifies if certain annotations (attributes) are present on grain interfaces and types, and reports diagnostics if not. The analyzer is likely used for code quality, validation, or enforcing conventions related to Orleans grains.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer
classes.description: A DiagnosticAnalyzer that inspects C# syntax nodes related to Orleans grain interfaces and classes for proper attribute annotations and reporting diagnostics accordingly.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes syntax nodes to identify interface and type declarations, and reports diagnostics if they lack required attributes.

methods.name: GetArity
methods.description: Calculates the number of nested types, representing the arity of a type declaration.

methods.name: GetNamespaceAndNesting
methods.description: Builds a string representing the namespace and nesting hierarchy of a type declaration.

methods.name: ReportFor
methods.description: Creates and reports a diagnostic message with associated properties for a specific syntax node.
